categories.name: Courses & textbook
categories.blurb: Course sites, the open Human Sexuality textbook, and interactive 3D anatomy models.

categories.name: Classroom activities & games
categories.blurb: Short interactive demos built for lecture. Most work on a phone, and several come in 720×450 versions for embedding in Top Hat.

categories.name: Teaching tools
categories.blurb: Utilities for running a class: attendance, scheduling, grading, and building apps with AI.

PSYCH-110.name: Human Sexuality
PSYCH-110.summary: An open online textbook by Dr. Ross Avilla: 15 chapters with pop-up definitions and practice questions, the PSYCH-110 syllabus, and small classroom apps. Licensed CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

PSYCH-C1000.name: Introduction to Psychology
PSYCH-C1000.summary: The PSYCH-C1000 course site: syllabus, a get-to-know-your-professor page, and a Myth or Fact? warm-up.

3D-Anatomy.name: 3D Anatomy Viewers
3D-Anatomy.summary: Interactive three.js models that run in the browser. Click any structure to see its name and what it does.

PSY157.name: Attribution Theory
PSY157.summary: Read five everyday scenarios, like a student who's always late to class, and classify each cause as internal or external, stable or unstable, and controllable or uncontrollable.

Attachment_Games.name: Attachment Styles Lab
Attachment_Games.summary: Find your attachment style, spot the styles in a text-message exchange, and see how different styles pair up.

hookup-sti-risk-game.name: The Hook-Up Game
hookup-sti-risk-game.summary: Model a year of choices (partners, condoms, HPV vaccination), see your odds of contracting an STI, then roll the dice.

Orgasm-Description.name: Describing Orgasm
Orgasm-Description.summary: A classroom replication of Vance & Wagner (1976). Students describe an orgasm anonymously, then try to guess each writer's anatomy.

Marriage-Rates.name: Changing Marriage Rates
Marriage-Rates.summary: How the share of married U.S. adults ages 25–34 fell from 86 to 34 per 100 between 1970 and 2025, with a Pick-a-Year spinner game.

height-and-salary-dating-sim.name: Dating Messages Simulator
height-and-salary-dating-sim.summary: Adjust height and salary to see how each relates to the number of messages received on dating apps.

FastFaceJudgements.name: Fast Face Judgments
FastFaceJudgements.summary: Pairs of faces flash faster every round, down to 60 ms, to show how quickly we judge attractiveness.

links.label: Why some faces are more attractive

Sex-Positions.name: Position Yourself
Sex-Positions.summary: An inclusive, mobile-first guide to 56 sex positions sorted by body arrangement, plus a partner matcher quiz.

KinkDeck.name: KinkDeck
KinkDeck.summary: Swipe through 20 cards across 10 kinks for a quick, playful breakdown. Nothing is stored.

tat.name: TAT Images
tat.summary: Picture cards for a Thematic Apperception Test (TAT) demonstration.

TH-Apps.name: Top Hat Apps
TH-Apps.summary: Single-file activities built to drop into a Top Hat slide at 720×450. First up: a Locus of Control quiz that scores you from internal to external across five bands.

PSY170.name: Achievement Motivation Scale
PSY170.summary: Rate 15 statements to get a 1–10 score for McClelland's needs for achievement, power, and affiliation, plotted as a needs profile. Built at 720×450 for Top Hat.

class-attendance.name: Class Check-In
class-attendance.summary: Students enter the session code from the instructor to check in, and attendance is recorded in Google Sheets.

sclass-scheduler.name: Semester Grid
sclass-scheduler.summary: Build a week-by-week class schedule for a semester and paste the table straight into Google Docs.

ExamDistribution.name: Exam Grade Distribution
ExamDistribution.summary: Merge Canvas exam scores into the gradebook, preview a curve and grade distribution, and export Canvas-ready files and a PDF report.

THandAI.name: From Prompt to App
THandAI.summary: A walkthrough for instructors: describe a class activity in plain language, have AI write the app, and publish it.

DECA.name: DECA Family Hub
DECA.summary: Mobile hub for Denair Elementary Charter Academy families: the 2026–27 school calendar, bell schedule, lunch menu, and Parents Club events.

weekly-menu.name: Week Plan
weekly-menu.summary: A mobile weekly meal plan with recipes and a built-in timer.
